historical_references.reference: The Hindu king Prathik of the Ikshvaku dynasty is mentioned in the Mahabharata. He ruled the region of Anga around the 11th or 12th century BCE.
Prathivadi Maarka Prathik was a Mauryan king who ruled the northern part of the Mauryan Empire around the 3rd century BCE. He was a contemporary of Emperor Ashoka.
